The '''Caravanserai Common Bazaar''' is one of four orcish workshops used for trade. General goods can be bought or sold here. Copper coins may be exchanged for silver or silver coins for gold using 5,000 coins at a 25:5:2 rate. These coins can also be used to invite [[cv:Immigration|immigrants]] for 5,000 silver or [[cv:Caravan|caravans]] (either from the taiga orcs, or from all allies) for 5,000 gold. The diplomacy skill is used for inviting immigrants or caravans.

== Sold ==
* [[cv:Cloth|Cloth]] (500 copper coins)
* [[cv:Leather|Leather]] (500 copper coins)

== Bought ==
* 10 [[anthracite]] boulders (3,000 platinum coins)
* [[cv:Bronze|Bronze]] crates (5,000 silver coins)
* [[cv:Iron|Iron]] crates (5,000 gold coins)
* [[cv:Steel|Steel]] crates (3,000 platinum coins)
* [[cv:Iron|Iron]] [[cv:Anvil|anvils]] (1,000 gold coins)
* 12 [[cv:Gabbro|gabbro]] [[cv:Mechanism|mechanisms]] (2,000 silver coins)
* [[Ashland Glassblower]] blueprints (5,000 gold coins)
